llms.body:
# TeraBox - 1TB Cloud and AI workspace

> Get 1TB of secure cloud backup and a powerful AI workspace with TeraBox. Generate PPTs, create stunning visuals, and convert PDFs effortlessly—all with your all-in-one AI co-pilot.

## Navigation and AI Tools

- [TeraBox Home](https://www.terabox.com/): Official homepage for cloud storage access and login.
- [AI Workspace Hub](https://www.terabox.com/ai/index): Central gateway for all TeraBox AI productivity tools.
- [AI Presentation Maker](https://www.terabox.com/ai/presentation-maker): One-click PPT generation from text or files.
- [AI Notebook](https://www.terabox.com/ai/notebook): AI turns your scattered stuff into a clean, structured notebook.
- [Nano Slides](https://www.terabox.com/ai/presentation-maker-nano): Create beautiful slides with Nano Banana.
- [Presentation Agent](https://www.terabox.com/ai/presentation-maker-agent): Intelligent assistant for structuring slide content.
- [Beautify Slides](https://www.terabox.com/ai/presentation-maker-beautify): AI-driven slide enhancement and layout optimization.
- [PDF Converter](https://www.terabox.com/ai/conversion?type=convertFromPdf): Convert PDFs to and from Word, Excel, PPT, JPG, PNG, and more.
- [GenFlow](https://www.terabox.com/ai/genflow): AI assistant for dialogue and complex task automation.
- [Deep Research](https://www.terabox.com/ai/research-report): AI-powered deep data gathering and report generation.
- [AI Image](https://www.terabox.com/ai/photo-to-photo): AI photo-to-photo and text-to-image creation.
- [AI Video](https://www.terabox.com/ai/photo-to-video): Transform text or photos into AI-generated video clips.
- [AI Essay Writer](https://www.terabox.com/ai/essay-writer): Intelligent drafting for essays and long-form content.
- [AI Paraphraser](https://www.terabox.com/ai/paraphraser): Best AI paraphrasing tool for your text.
- [AI Transcriber](https://www.terabox.com/ai/transcriber): Convert audio and video recordings into text.
- [AI PDF to PPT](https://www.terabox.com/ai/pdf-to-ppt): Upload a PDF to create professional AI slides instantly.
- [AI Word to PPT](https://www.terabox.com/ai/word-to-ppt): AI creates PowerPoint slides from your word files.
- [AI Doc to PPT](https://www.terabox.com/ai/doc-to-ppt): Create engaging presentations from documents.
- [AI Text to PPT](https://www.terabox.com/ai/text-to-ppt): AI generates PPT slides from your text.
- [Presentation Templates](https://www.terabox.com/ai/presentation-templates): Find the best free PowerPoint presentation templates.
- [AI Doc Scanner App](https://www.terabox.com/ai/doc-scanner): Quickly scan documents to PDF and more within TeraBox app.
- [AI Search Assistant](https://www.terabox.com/ai/search-assistant): Search and watch movies, TV shows, and more on mobile.

## Downloads and Pricing

- [TeraBox for PC](https://www.terabox.com/terabox-cloud-storage-for-pc-free-download): Desktop client for Windows/Mac.
- [TeraBox APK](https://www.terabox.com/terabox-cloud-storage-for-apk-free-download): Android package for mobile installation.
- [TeraAIpix PC](https://www.teraaipix.ai/): Professional AI image tool for desktop.
- [Pricing](https://www.terabox.com/cloud-storage-pricing-plans): Premium storage plans and AI feature subscriptions.

## Support and Ecosystem

- [Help Center](https://www.terabox.com/help-center): Troubleshooting, FAQs, and user guides.
- [TeraBox Blog](https://blog.terabox.com/): Product news, cloud storage tips, and AI updates.
- [Referral Program](https://www.terabox.com/webmaster/index): Webmaster and referral rewards center.
- [About Us](https://www.terabox.com/about-us): Mission, vision, and company background.
